items.reason: A gentle, fragrance-free style cleanser that suits dry-feeling skin without stripping it.
A gentle niacinamide serum to help even the look of dark patches over time; keep it away from the mole.
A ceramide moisturizer to support comfort and moisture on dry-looking skin.
Tinted mineral SPF with iron oxides helps keep the look of dark patches from deepening and suits deeper skin tones.

response.routine_note: Please have the mole on your cheek that has grown and darkened checked by a dermatologist soon, as no product from a shop is the right answer for that, and avoid applying any serums directly on it. In the meantime, use the cleanser, serum and moisturizer morning and evening, and finish your morning routine with the SPF.
